examples.title: SciR example
examples.prompt:
Deduction task. Decide whether the hypothesis follows from the premises.

Every member of commitment regeneration signal is either a member of osteoblast commitment or a member of fibroblast commitment, or both.
Every member of fibroblast commitment is either a member of fibroblast marker vimentin or a member of fibroblast marker fibronectin, or both.
Whatever is a member of MMP signaling, is not a member of ossified fin matrix.
Whatever is a member of osteoblast commitment, is not a member of differentiated fin cells.
Whatever is a member of dedifferentiated osteoblasts, is not a member of differentiated fin cells.
Every member of FGF signaling is either a member of MMP signaling or a member of Wnt signaling, or both.
Whatever is a member of Wnt signaling, is not a member of ossified fin matrix.
Something is a member of blastema cells and not both a member of osterix marker and a member of collagen1 marker.
Whatever is a member of fibroblast marker vimentin, is not a member of differentiated fin cells.
Whatever is a member of retinoic acid signaling, is not a member of ossified fin matrix.
Every member of preosteoblast state is a member of collagen1 marker.
Whatever is a member of dedifferentiated fibroblasts, is not a member of differentiated fin cells.
Every member of activated regeneration cells is either a member of early regeneration progenitors or a member of commitment regeneration signal, or both.
Whatever is not a member of ossified fin matrix, is a member of preosteoblast state.
Whatever is a member of early regeneration progenitors, is not a member of differentiated fin cells.
Every member of preosteoblast state is a member of osterix marker.
Whatever is a member of fibroblast marker fibronectin, is not a member of differentiated fin cells.
Every member of dedifferentiated fin progenitors is either a member of dedifferentiated osteoblasts or a member of dedifferentiated fibroblasts, or both.
Every member of blastema cells is either a member of dedifferentiated fin progenitors or a member of activated regeneration cells, or both.

Hypothesis: Whatever is a member of blastema cells, is not a member of differentiated fin cells.

Label the hypothesis as one of: valid, invalid, unknown.
examples.output: Follow the requested answer or artifact format in the task.
